subject: Model slate + context budget: kickoff and quick asks
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sam Liu <sam.liu@clearwave.com>, onboarding@clearwave.com
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Model slate + context budget: kickoff and quick asks

Hi Sam / ClearWave onboarding team —

Thanks for the kickoff yesterday. As we move into the implementation planning window we want to lock down two things that materially affect model choice and capacity: (1) the preferred context budget (per-session max context length), and (2) a realistic distribution of token volumes (session counts, avg/session, and long-tail percent).

Quick ask: can you share — ideally this week — a small sample (10–50) of representative conversations (anonymized) and a rough metric for concurrent active users during peak hour? We often see big differences between median and 95th-percentile session length that change which model/config is cost-optimal.

What we propose initially (internal recommendation to discuss with you):
- Shortlist: Llama-2-13B-chat (quantized 8-bit), Mistral-Instruct-7B (fp16), and a smaller local fallback Redstone-3.5B (q4).
- Default context target: 16k tokens for primary flows; we can offer a 32k option for clinical-document-heavy flows if you confirm >5% of sessions need it.
- Initial token-volume estimate request: please provide avg tokens per session, avg sessions per user/day, and expected DAU/MAU. If you can only provide a percentile (median/95th) that also helps.

Attached: clearwave_context_samples.csv (format template) and token_profile_estimates.xlsx (we filled an example row) — fill and return.

Internal note: Grace — can you draft a quick throughput sketch once Sam sends samples? Priyom — can you capture any constraints on data retention or private deployment needs; ClearWave mentioned an internal security review.

Proposed next step: 30-min sizing call Thur Aug 17 or Fri Aug 18. Sam, which slot works best?

Thanks,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0121

Attachments: clearwave_context_samples.csv (csv), token_profile_estimates.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Sam Liu <sam.liu@clearwave.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: onboarding@clearwave.com, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 10:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Model slate + context budget: kickoff and quick asks

Ben — thanks, and appreciate the template. Attaching a redacted batch of 25 recent transcripts (sample_conversations.jsonl) and our quick answers below:

- Peak concurrent active users (web app): ~38 (measured last Friday during a product demo week).
- Avg tokens/session: 1,050 tokens (median ~420, 95th ~4,800) — the distribution is long-tailed because we have some document summarization flows.
- Sessions per user/day: 1.1 on average; DAU currently ~4,500 but active pilot users during the trial will be ~350.
- Security: we can share full sample only under an NDA (we have one active with Redwood). For now, redacted text is in the sample file.

We expect about 6% of sessions to need >16k context (long-form summarization of multi-document bundles). If that matters for sizing now, cost estimates for a 32k profile would be helpful.

I can do Fri Aug 18 at 09:30 PT for the sizing call.

—Sam
Senior Product Manager, ClearWave Health
sam.liu@clearwave.com

Attachments: sample_conversations.jsonl (jsonl)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Liu <sam.liu@clearwave.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Aug 2028 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Model slate + context budget: kickoff and quick asks

Thanks for the samples, Sam — these are helpful. Quick internal sizing sketch based on the provided numbers:

Assumptions (pilot window):
- Pilot DAU: 350 users (as Ben noted, pilot cohort), average sessions/user/day: 1.1 -> ~385 sessions/day.
- Avg tokens/session: 1,050 -> baseline tokens/day: ~404k tokens/day.
- Long-tail (~95th) sessions: ~6% of sessions require longer context (we'll treat as 32k-profile flows). That’s roughly 23 sessions/day at 4,800 tokens avg -> an extra ~110k tokens/day.
- Total token/day (pilot): ~514k tokens/day.

Throughput & concurrency sizing (SLO target: p95 latency < 350ms for short flows, < 800ms for long flows):
- Peak concurrency estimate (from Sam): 38 concurrent active users -> estimate concurrent model requests ~25 (not every active user sends a live request).
- For Llama-2-13B-chat (quantized) at 16k context and typical batching, we estimate needing 1 dedicated GPU-equivalent (high-end A100/RTX-class throughput) for pilot target with headroom for spikes; Mistral-7B (fp16) could serve the majority of short-chat flows more cost-effectively and handle bursts as fallback.

Cost/operational notes:
- Recommend enabling KV-prefix caching for repeated system prompts and common prefixes — expect ~10–18% token reduction on interactive flows.
- For the ~6% long-form flows, consider allowing Redwood to route those to a 32k-config model variant with explicit fallbacks; only enable the 32k variant for sessions that request it to avoid unit-cost inflation.

Deliverables I can produce for the call:
- 1-page pilot sizing slide with token/day, throughput and model recommendation (PDF).
- A short canary plan: 48-hour canary at 20% of pilot traffic, with smoke tests and latency/cost gates.

Attaching initial-sizing-notes.pdf with the above math and a sample breakdown.

Grace
Lead Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com

Attachments: initial-sizing-notes.pdf (pdf)

Thanks Sam / Grace — this is great and gives us enough to move forward. Quick summary / next steps: 

1) Confirmed Fri Aug 18 09:30 PT for a 30-min sizing call (I'll send calendar invite).
2) Grace to present the pilot sizing slide and the 48-hour canary plan.
3) Sam to confirm whether pilot should include the 32k variant opt-in (we'll assume opt-in disabled by default unless you confirm).
4) Priyom, please prepare a short checklist of security artifacts ClearWave might need (SOC2 evidence, retention controls) and link the NDA status in the call notes.

Ben — I'll prepare the invite and include the drive link to the slide + a sample HubSpot record. If Sam confirms the 32k opt-in we’ll produce cost delta estimates pre-call.

Best,
Ben
